cohort: Singleton births in Finland from 1990-2005, with cases (n = 4713) identified from the Finnish Hospital Discharge Register and matched to four controls
finding: Low Apgar scores and conditions requiring neonatal special follow-up are important risk factors for childhood autism and PDD, suggesting fetal distress as a potential risk factor, but not for Asperger syndrome.
mod_finding: Planned cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of PDD (OR 1.34, 95% CI 1.1-1.7, P = .009).
